title: FluxCell: a second-order shallow-water solver for WebGPU
description: FluxCell is a JavaScript and WGSL library that solves the two-dimensional shallow-water equations on the GPU in a web browser, using WebGPU. It implements a conservative, well-balanced, second-order finite-volume scheme: unsplit MUSCL-Hancock reconstruction, an HLLC Riemann solver with HLL fallback, and hydrostatic reconstruction, with wetting and drying, Manning friction, rain and point sources, solid cells, stage, discharge, and incident-wave boundaries, wind, Coriolis, a transported tracer with settling, and an eddy-viscosity closure. A fused, tiled kernel chooses its timestep on the GPU and runs up to 256 steps per submission, with rollback and retry of failed steps. Double-precision CPU references and in-browser verification suites (SWASHES, UK Environment Agency 2D benchmarks, NTHMP laboratory benchmarks) are included.
